# Justify Self

::: tip 实现进度 90% · 已完成
活示例对标 Amis Justify Self：`justify-self-auto` / `start` / `end` / `center` / `stretch` 落在同一子项的 `justify-self`。独立样例 + 组合；`m:` / `pc:` 已进 helper，不支持状态前缀。只改第一枚，第二枚保持 stretch。
:::

单个 Grid 子项覆盖 `justify-items`。类打在子项上，不是容器。Amis 五档与 Justify Items 同值。舞台两列 `w-80`，只动第一枚的 left / 宽。Vamis schema `className` 打在外层 `div.vamis-node`；本页用 HTML 岛把 self 类打在第一枚上。

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `justify-self-auto` | `justify-self: auto` |
| `justify-self-start` | `justify-self: start` |
| `justify-self-end` | `justify-self: end` |
| `justify-self-center` | `justify-self: center` |
| `justify-self-stretch` | `justify-self: stretch` |

## justify-self-auto

`justify-self: auto`。跟父级默认 stretch：第一枚宽 152px，left 8。第二枚未写 self，同样拉满。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 w-80 bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md shrink-0">
    <div class="justify-self-auto h-16 shrink-0 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">1</div>
    <div class="h-16 shrink-0 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">2</div>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 w-80 bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md shrink-0">
    <div class="justify-self-auto h-16 shrink-0 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">1</div>
    <div class="h-16 shrink-0 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">2</div>
  </div>
```

## justify-self-start

`justify-self: start`。只改第一枚，钉死 64px 靠格左，left 8。第二枚仍 stretch 152px。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 w-80 bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md shrink-0">
    <div class="justify-self-start w-16 h-16 shrink-0 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">1</div>
    <div class="h-16 shrink-0 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">2</div>
  </div>
```

## 响应式设计

支持通过添加设备前缀 `m:` 或者 `pc:` 来分别针对「手机端」或者「pc端」设置样式，更多说明请前往[「辅助类-响应式设计」](/style/responsive-design)。窄屏第一枚 `m:justify-self-start` 靠左；桌面（≥768px）`pc:justify-self-end` 靠右，left 96px。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 w-80 bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md shrink-0">
    <div class="m:justify-self-start pc:justify-self-end w-16 h-16 shrink-0 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">1</div>
    <div class="h-16 shrink-0 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">2</div>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 w-80 bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md shrink-0">
    <div class="m:justify-self-start pc:justify-self-end w-16 h-16 shrink-0 bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">1</div>
    <div class="h-16 shrink-0 bg-yellow-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm rounded-md">2</div>
  </div>
```

## 状态前缀

本页与 Amis 一样：不支持[「状态前缀」](/style/state)。整列格子见 [Justify Items](/style/box-alignment/justify-items)。

其它 helper 见 [辅助类-响应式设计](/style/responsive-design)、[辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
